violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pizza prep cutting boards need cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floor in walk-in-freezer has ice buildup that needs to be removed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Several ceiling tiles and vent covers in kitchen area in need of cleaning.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. - Coat hanging on shelf with kitchen items, next to office door.
